import os
import tempfile
import shutil
import pytest

# Import the public API that is available in the codebase
from doorstop.core.item import Item
from doorstop.core.document import Document
from doorstop.core.tree import Tree
from doorstop.core.prefix import Prefix
from doorstop.core.types import UID
from doorstop.core.vcs.mockvcs import WorkingCopy as MockVCS
from doorstop.core.vcs import find_root
from doorstop.core import importer, exporter


@pytest.fixture
def temp_dir():
    """Create a temporary directory for the test and clean up afterwards."""
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    yield d
    shutil.rmtree(d)


@pytest.fixture
def tree(temp_dir):
    """Create a minimal Doorstop tree in a temporary directory."""
    # The Tree constructor expects a root path; we use the temp dir
    return Tree(temp_dir)


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_001(temp_dir, tree):
    """
    Doorstop provides unique and permanent identifiers to linkable sections of text
    """
    # Create a new requirement item
    doc = Document.new(tree, temp_dir, "REQ", "REQ")
    uid = UID("REQ-1")
    item = Item.new(tree, doc, temp_dir, temp_dir, uid, auto=False)
    item.set("text", "Some requirement")
    item.save()

    # The UID should be an instance of UID and unique within the tree
    assert isinstance(item.uid, UID)
    # Ensure no other item shares the same UID
    items = [i for i in tree if i.uid == item.uid]
    assert len(items) == 1


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_002(temp_dir, tree):
    """
    Doorstop supports formatting within linkable text – bold
    """
    doc = Document.new(tree, temp_dir, "REQ", "REQ")
    uid = UID("REQ-2")
    item = Item.new(tree, doc, temp_dir, temp_dir, uid, auto=False)
    # Markdown style bold
    item.set("text", "*Bold Text*")
    item.save()

    # The stored text should be converted to LaTeX bold syntax
    # (the implementation uses ** for bold)
    assert "**Bold Text**" in item.text


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_003(temp_dir, tree):
    """
    Doorstop supports formatting within linkable text – italic
    """
    doc = Document.new(tree, temp_dir, "REQ", "REQ")
    uid = UID("REQ-3")
    item = Item.new(tree, doc, temp_dir, temp_dir, uid, auto=False)
    item.set("text", "_Italic Text_")
    item.save()

    # The stored text should be converted to LaTeX italic syntax
    # (the implementation uses * for italic)
    assert "*Italic Text*" in item.text


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_004(temp_dir, tree):
    """
    Doorstop supports formatting within linkable text – code
    """
    doc = Document.new(tree, temp_dir, "REQ", "REQ")
    uid = UID("REQ-4")
    item = Item.new(tree, doc, temp_dir, temp_dir, uid, auto=False)
    item.set("text", "`Code Text`")
    item.save()

    # The stored text should preserve backticks for code formatting
    assert "`Code Text`" in item.text


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_005(temp_dir, tree):
    """
    Doorstop supports formatting within linkable text – link
    """
    doc = Document.new(tree, temp_dir, "REQ", "REQ")
    uid = UID("REQ-5")
    item = Item.new(tree, doc, temp_dir, temp_dir, uid, auto=False)
    item.set("text", "[Link](http://url)")
    item.save()

    # The stored text should preserve the markdown link syntax
    assert "[Link](http://url)" in item.text


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_006(temp_dir, tree):
    """
    Doorstop supports the storage of external requirements assets
    """
    # Create a document and an asset file
    doc = Document.new(tree, temp_dir, "REQ", "REQ")
    asset_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, "external_asset.txt")
    with open(asset_path, "w") as f:
        f.write("asset content")

    # Copy the asset into the document's assets folder
    doc.copy_assets([asset_path])

    # Verify the asset is now accessible in the document
    stored_asset = os.path.join(doc.assets, "external_asset.txt")
    assert os.path.isfile(stored_asset)
    with open(stored_asset) as f:
        assert f.read() == "asset content"
